description: The Order class already stores its list of item prices on the instance in __init__. Implement its total method, which returns the sum of all item prices.
test_code:
import pytest
from main import Order

test_cases = [
    ([100, 250], 350),
    ([999], 999),
]

validation_cases = [
    pytest.param([], 0, marks=pytest.mark.validate),
    pytest.param([1200, 300, 4500], 6000, marks=pytest.mark.validate),
]

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input1", "expected_output"), test_cases + validation_cases
)
def test_order_total(input1, expected_output):
    print("\n---------------------------------")
    print(f"Inputs: {input1}")
    result = Order(input1).total()
    print(f"Expected: {expected_output}")
    print(f"Actual:   {result}")
    assert result == expected_output
